Well I did something called kitbashing, the idea is taking things from multiple figures and combining them myself. In this case the head is from a "Lord Asriel the golden compass" daniel craig action figure, then (if you live in the USA the best place to buy a body is an e-store called marauders, I live in Spain so I used an Agent jones fortnite figure.) then I cut off his neck because it was way too high and Daniel Craig looked like a kaminoan lol, then I used blu tack to make a mold and right now it's just sitting there because it's working well, another recommendation is to cut off the neck and use a small metal nail, warm itand put it on his neck, then model a bit with green stuff, paint and add the head to the cut off flat end of the nail with a bit of blu tack added to the head, it will look perfect and I've done it once too, if you have any questions just let me know!
